subcommands.description: Give SKU recommendations for Azure SQL offerings

options.description: Path of the ConfigFile
options.name: --config-file-path

options.description: Space separated list of names of databases to be allowed for SKU recommendation consideration while excluding all others. Only set one of the following or neither: databaseAllowList, databaseDenyList. Default: null

options.name: --database-deny-list

options.description: Whether or not to print the SKU recommendation results to the console. Enable this parameter to display result
options.name: --display-result

options.name: --elastic-strategy

options.description: UTC end time of performance data points to consider during aggregation, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. Only used for baseline (non-elastic) strategy. Default: all data points collected will be considered

options.name: --output-folder

options.description: Whether or not to overwrite any existing SKU recommendation reports. Enable this paramater to overwrite
options.name: --overwrite

options.description: Scaling (comfort) factor used during SKU recommendation. For example, if it is determined that there is a 4 vCore CPU requirement with a scaling factor of 150%, then the true CPU requirement will be 6 vCores
options.name: --scaling-factor

options.description: UTC start time of performance data points to consider during aggregation, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. Only used for baseline (non-elastic) strategy. Default: all data points collected will be considered
options.name: --start-time

options.description: Percentile of data points to be used during aggregation of the performance data. Only used for baseline (non-elastic) strategy
options.name: --target-percentile

options.description: Target platform for SKU recommendation: either AzureSqlDatabase, AzureSqlManagedInstance, AzureSqlVirtualMachine, or Any. If Any is selected, then SKU recommendations for all three target platforms will be evaluated, and the best fit will be returned
